title: Documents are proved by primary or secondary evidence (BSA ss

content.overview: Documents are proved by primary or secondary evidence (BSA ss. 56–60). Electronic and digital records are not to be denied merely because they are electronic (s. 61), subject to ss. 62–63. s. 63 is the current home of the old 65B certificate scheme.
